Both captures say the generated QR code itself does not expire, but deactivating its underlying Payment Link makes a scan redirect to an expiration page (old:26-28; new:27-29). Existing source wiki/sources/source-stripe-payment-links.md:67 abbreviates this as 'QR code (never expires)' without the link-state qualification. These are link-state operations, not cancellation or reversal of completed payments. Preserve the current source:67 deactivation/reactivation/cannot-delete summary with this scope.
